I. FOREWORD
0.1 This IndiaD Staadard wal adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 7 February 1980, after the draft finalized by the Pelt Control Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council and the Chemical Dl vision Council. 0.2 Carbaryl granule. are generally manufactured to contain 4 percent ( m/", ) of carbaryl.
0.3 In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the provi.~onl of the Insecticides Act, 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However, thi. standard is subject to the restriction. impoled under these, wherever applicable.

O.t For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expTelling the result of a telt or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960-. The number of significant places retained in tbe rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in thil atandard.
